deleteSource.label: Delete sources
deleteSource.heading: Delete selected sources and folders?
deleteSource.contributions: Removes these sources’ contributions to propositions and reasoning chains. Knowledge supported by other sources survives; knowledge supported only by these sources is removed.
deleteSource.filesNote: Imported source records are removed, but original files on disk are never changed. Selected folders are removed only when empty; folders needed by kept sessions remain.
deleteSource.sessionsCheckbox: {count, plural, one {Also delete the # selected session} other {Also delete the # selected sessions}}
deleteSource.sessionsNote: Unchecked, conversations stay in their current folders and can be extracted again. Either way, their graph contributions and extraction coverage are cleared. Checking this also permanently deletes their messages and background jobs.

deleteNode.label: Delete node
deleteNode.headingNodesAndFolders: Delete nodes and remove empty folders?
deleteNode.permanenceOne: This permanently deletes the node — this cannot be undone.
deleteNode.permanenceMany: This permanently deletes all {count} nodes — this cannot be undone.
deleteNode.onlyNamedFolders: Only the named empty folders are removed.
deleteNode.keptLine: Sessions, imported source records, and non-empty folders are kept.

session.label: Delete session
session.heading: Delete session?
session.body: This permanently removes the session — its messages, background jobs, and extraction records. Everything it added to the graph stays unless you check below. This cannot be undone.

traces.title: Also remove its graph traces
traces.body: This session’s topics, links, and events leave the graph too. Topics other sessions or imported notes also cover survive; topics only this session created are removed entirely.

folder.label: Delete folder
folder.heading: Delete folder?
folder.body: This permanently removes the folder and the {what} inside — the sessions’ messages, background jobs, and extraction records. Everything they added to the graph stays unless you check below.{notes} This cannot be undone.
folder.notesMove: {count, plural, one {# imported notes file} other {# imported notes files}} inside {count, plural, one {moves} other {move}} to {target}.
folder.tracesBody: These sessions’ topics, links, and events leave the graph too. Topics other sessions or imported notes also cover survive; topics only these sessions created are removed entirely.

delete.failedNetwork: Delete failed — network error. Try again.
delete.folderChanged: This folder changed. Nothing was deleted.
delete.nodeExtractionRunning: An extraction is running — try again when the activity dock drains.

turn.title: Abort this turn?
turn.line: The partial answer stays in the transcript.

question.title: Dismiss this question?
question.line: Skipped — the teacher moves on without it.

problem.title: Discard this problem?
problem.line: The problem is dropped — no solution is revealed.

question.confidenceAria: Confidence — the probability your selected answer is correct
question.confidenceTitle: The probability your selected answer is correct — 50% is a coin flip. Adjust with ←/→.
question.thinkingPlaceholder: Why this answer? Whatever comes to mind.

chat.planDivider: Plan · {count, plural, one {# node} other {# nodes}}
chat.nextPlaceholder: Ask anything, or press Enter for the next one.
